demos.name: Privilege API Explorer LAB
demos.description: Sign in to a PingOne Privilege console with a user API key and secret, then browse all 447 console API operations from the swagger catalog with substring search and filters, and run each one live with real-time status, timing and response. Mock by default; Real is owner-run.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 7813; npm run doctor checks it). Or: HOST_PORT=7813 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock mode needs no setup; Real is refused until the owner sets PRIVILEGE_EXPLORER_MODE=real. The composeFile is relative to the folder the demo repos sit in.
